name: CloseComfort Personal Air Conditioner with Igloo Bed Tent (2 sets)
description:
Compact personal air conditioner with a real compressor, so it cools much better than a fan or water cooler. Each set comes with a pop-up bed tent and can be used in two ways:
With the tent: The cold-air vent fits into the tent's built-in inlet, and the flexible duct carries the hot exhaust out of the tent. The sleeping space stays properly cool all night.
On its own: Point the cold-air vent at where you sit or sleep for directed cooling. Direct the hot-air duct away from you, ideally towards a window or doorway.
Very low electricity use: It uses about 300W on its own and about 180W on average with the tent. That is roughly a quarter of what a typical room air-con uses, or about the same as two to three fans. This makes it a good option for households that want cool, comfortable sleep without high electricity bills.
Suitable for someone without air-conditioning, especially elderly or less mobile people who struggle with the heat at night.
Included (per set):
Air conditioner unit
Flexible extendable hot-air exhaust duct
Pop-up Igloo bed tent in carry bag
Quantity: 2 sets (can go to one household or two separate beneficiaries)
Condition:
Set 1: Used, in good working condition. Cleaned and tested. Minor surface marks on the casing from normal use.
Set 2: Used, in working condition. The cold-air outlet cover is cracked at one corner and no longer holds its position on its own. It is secured with a strap tied around the cover and exhaust duct, as shown in the photo, and the unit cools normally this way. A tie-down strap is included.
location: Farrer Park, Little India, Serangoon Road
